description: This planning application seeks to add additions to a ground floor rear extension approved under permission reference number no: 2025/0818. The proposals seek to add a privacy screen, small access stair and balustrade to the rear single storey extension, seeking to maintain this as a route of access, which is present in the dwelling's current existing use. They also seek to maintain the ground floor rear door as a door.
decision_conditions:
The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

All new external finishes in respect of the works hereby approved (and any other incidental works to be carried out in this connection) and the installation of replacement windows shall be constructed in accordance with those specified under permission ref 2025/1694, unless otherwise stated on the drawings hereby approved.REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area.

A scheme for the provision and implementation of flood resilient and resistant construction details and measures for the site against surface water flood risk shall be implemented prior to superstructure works in accordance with the details approved under permission ref 2025/1694.The scheme shall be carried out in its entirety before the extension is occupied and constructed and completed in accordance with the approved plans in line with current best practices.REASON: In the interests of prevention of harm to human health and property as a result of flood.

A sustainable drainage system in the form of permeable paving shall be installed prior to superstructure works in accordance with the details approved under ref 2025/1694. REASON: To address adaptation to, and mitigation of, climate change; provide sustainable urban drainage and manage surface water run-off as close to source as possible; enhance biodiversity values; and improve the appearance and resilience of the development.

Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved a minimum of one Swift nesting bricks and/or boxes shall be provided at or close to eaves level of the development hereby approved. The bricks/boxes shall be retained thereafter in perpetuity. REASON: In the interests of biodiversity

<p>The privacy screen as shown on drawings&nbsp;34GR-PR-E-111 C &amp;&nbsp;34GR-PR-E-113 D &amp; 34GR-PR-P-201 D hereby approved shall be installed prior to its first use and retained thereafter.</p><p>
REASON: In the interests of neighbours amenity.</p>
